title: Reno, NV — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]

content:
Overview

Reno is a city in NV with a population of 273,448. The Biggest Little City with no state income tax, Tahoe proximity, and a tech boom. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 252 sunny days a year.
